test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I can’t control my ______ these days because I got selected for a job.
solution:
The correct answer is 'excitement.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us see the **meanings **of the given options:

 
 
• **Casualness: **​lack of care or thought; an apparent lack of care or thought. (देखभाल या विचार की कमी)
 
• **Nepotism: **using your power or influence to give unfair advantage to your family, especially by giving them jobs. (अपने अधिकार या प्रभाव से परिवार के सदस्‍यों का अनुचित लाभ (विशेषतः नौकरी देना) पहुँचाना; भाई-भतीजावाद, कुनबापरस्‍ती)
 
• **Pollution: **the action of making the air, water, etc. dirty and dangerous. (वायु, नदियों आदि को प्रदूषित करने की प्रक्रिया; प्रदूषण)
 
• **Excitement: **the state of being excited, especially because something interesting is happening or will happen. (उत्तेजना, उत्‍साहमयी प्रसन्‍नता)
 
 
 
• The given sentence refers to the state of being excited as the boy got selected for a job.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

 ​

Correct sentence: *I can’t control my **excitement**__ these days because I got selected for a job.*
